title: "It's Done Babe": She Skimmed $80K From a Juror Bribe

lines.say: Eighty thousand dollars. That's how much the courier kept for herself, out of a two hundred thousand dollar bribe meant for a juror.
lines.show: $80,000. That's how much the courier kept for herself, out of a $200,000 bribe meant for a juror.

lines.say: Ladan Ali told the plotters the juror wanted five hundred thousand. In the government's words, she fabricated this entire interaction.
lines.show: Ladan Ali told the plotters the juror wanted $500,000. In the government's words, she "fabricated this entire interaction."

scene.src: Gov't sentencing memo, Ladan Ali (D. Minn. 24-cr-173, Dkt. 277)

lines.say: She delivered the rest, and texted: It's done, babe.
lines.show: She delivered the rest, and texted: "It's done babe."

scene.src: Gov't sentencing memo, Abdimajid Nur (D. Minn. 24-cr-173, Dkt. 243)

lines.say: The juror called the police. Ali pleaded guilty. Four years in prison.
lines.show: The juror called the police. Ali pleaded guilty. Four years in prison.

scene.sub: Ladan Ali · Judge Eric C. Tostrud
